A beautifully presented one-bedroom apartment offering bright accommodation throughout. The stylish open-plan kitchen, dining and living area provides an inviting space for modern living, while the double bedroom is generously proportioned.

A well-maintained one-bedroom apartment, ideally situated within this conveniently located development. The standout feature is the bright and generously proportioned open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating an inviting and versatile living space.

Location
City Gate is a modern apartment development ideally located within walking distance of Sligo town centre and an excellent range of local amenities. Convenient access to the nearby Inner Relief Road ensures excellent connectivity to the surrounding area.
